name: route-ack-lost
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). B installs the route but its ROUTE_INSTALL_ACK is dropped on both of its links. The controller retries; B recognises the repeat, does not install twice, and acknowledges again.
